data.one_liner: Dart wrapper on SQLite providing the common API for sqflite and desktop FFI implementations.
data.what_it_does: It provides a platform-agnostic Dart wrapper and shared API for SQLite databases. It is primarily intended to allow developers to write logic shared across Flutter apps and desktop binaries.
use_when: You are writing platform-agnostic logic shared between Flutter and desktop binaries using SQLite.
You are developing a package that wraps sqflite APIs for multiple platforms.
avoid_when: You are writing a standard Flutter mobile app (use sqflite instead).
You are writing a desktop-only app (use sqflite_common_ffi instead).
strengths: Enables writing platform-agnostic business logic using sqlite_api.
Serves as the common foundation for sqflite and sqflite_common_ffi.
weaknesses: Not intended for direct use in standard applications.
Requires proper platform-specific implementations to be imported alongside it.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml and import sqlite_api.dart when writing shared cross-platform logic.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are building a Flutter mobile application and want standard SQLite support.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a reactive, type-safe SQL database library with code generation.

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a direct Dart binding to SQLite without the sqflite wrapper API.
